propositions: Rebar's structured-output extraction is schema-blind: tolerant_parse returns the first parseable JSON object found, allowing quoted tool results or examples to shadow the actual payload
Five recurrences of this defect class have been partially fixed but broken again by routine model provider swaps (e.g., Bedrock cutover changed trigger rate)
The prompted path must be hardened with schema-filtered candidate selection (last-valid-wins), explicit sentinel output channels, and optional replayable raw-reply artifacts on parse failure
Provider-native structured output must replace blanket thinking-compatibility guards with measured per-model capability gating, leaving unmeasured cells on the hardened prompted path
A reusable provider-matrix raw-output baseline/eval harness running as manual CI must produce before/after output distributions to measure effectiveness of all changes
